phase.title: Onboard ext-authz and reachable Go vulnerability checks

summary:
Completed Phase 9. Added `renovate.json`, the weekly/manual/default-branch govulncheck workflow, strict scan wrapper, README link, and `docs/dependency-automation.md`. Renovate validation passed and extracted 21 dependencies across Dockerfile, Go modules/directive, Actions, and the pinned scanner. Public lookup reproduced go-redis 9.7.3 and later v9 proposals; the anonymous Go builder lookup returned `no-result`, while GitHub/published-preset checks remain pending Phase 12.

Govulncheck v1.7.0 ran with the separate Go 1.26.8 analysis toolchain and reproduced reachable GO-2025-3540 from `NewSessionStore` through `Ping` to `initConn`. Text and valid JSON evidence were retained; findings are non-gating, while simulated operational failure correctly failed. Strict Renovate validation, actionlint, bash syntax, ShellCheck, `go test ./...`, whitespace checks, and `git diff --check` passed. `go.mod` and `go.sum` retain their original hashes. No upgrades or service/deployment changes were made. The pre-existing `AGENTS.md` edit was preserved untouched. Durable Phase 12 handoff: `docs/dependency-automation.md`.
